description: Puck positions read by eye (AI) from the registered broadcast frames (out/edwall/<goal_id>/<frame>.png: E half of the game-2 reference frame at 2x; scripts/edwall-frames.py) for Nygård's three Edwall long-shovel goals in game 2. Pixel = the centre of the dark puck blob (motion-blurred streaks: the streak centre, i.e. mid-exposure). kind: rest = puck still at the right wing's blade by the near board; streak = moving, blurred along its path; flight = free slide, blob still readable; hidden = not visible (under or behind a figure). Read with a 50 px grid; reading error about 10 px (2.5-3 mm) for sharp blobs, 20-30 px along a streak. World positions are back-projected onto the plane z = 6 mm (half the preview puck thickness) by scripts/edwall-observe.py. Status: PROPOSED (AI reading, not checked by the user).
